back_translation: Bel crouches down; Nebo stoops low. Their idols have become burdens on the backs of beasts and cattle. The things you once carried in procession are now loaded as heavy baggage on weary animals.
They stoop and crouch down together; they cannot rescue the burden, and they themselves go off into captivity.
"Listen to Me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, you whom I have upheld since the belly, carried since birth.
Even to your old age I am He, and until your hair turns gray I will still carry you. I have made you, and I will lift you up; I Myself will bear you and will save you.
To whom will you liken Me or count anyone as My equal? To whom will you compare Me, as if we were alike?
They pour out gold from their bags and weigh silver on the scales; they hire a goldsmith to make it into a god; then they bow down and worship it.

They lift it onto their shoulders and carry it; they set it down in its place, and there it stands, unable to move from its spot. Even if someone cries out to it, it cannot answer, nor can it save him from his distress.
Remember this and steady yourselves; take it to heart, you transgressors.
Remember the former things of long ago, for I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is no one like Me.
I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things not yet done. I say, 'My plan will stand, and I will accomplish all that I please.'
I call a bird of prey from the east, a man who will carry out My plan from a far country. Truly I have spoken, and truly I will bring it to pass; I have planned it, and I will accomplish it.
Listen to Me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness:
I have brought My righteousness near; it is not far off, and My salvation will not delay. I will grant salvation to Zion, and My glory to Israel."
